messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the person's action to raising both hands in celebration, then thrusting one hand upward, as demonstrated in the motion reference. Transfer only the demonstrated action; do not adopt the reference person's appearance, the reference scene, or the reference camera setup. Preserve all other aspects of the current video, including the person's identity, appearance, scene, lighting, and camera framing.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the person's action to raising both hands in celebration, then thrusting one hand upward, as demonstrated in the reference video. Transfer only the demonstrated action, not the reference person's appearance or the reference scene and camera setup. Preserve all other aspects of the current video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands with her back to the camera, then raises both arms overhead and performs a brief dance move before returning to a standing pose.","camera":"The camera remains static in a medium full shot from behind the character.","clothing":"She wears a pink off-the-shoulder top with white puffed sleeves, black shorts with a gold baroque pattern, and light blue slip-on shoes.","hair_color":"Her hair is bright blue.","hairstyle":"Her hair is styled in two high buns on top of her head.","identity":"A slim, light-skinned female character is shown from behind, with her face not visible.","scene":"The setting is a cobblestone street in front of old-style buildings with shop signs and a black street lamp."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output character now raises both arms overhead in a celebratory motion and then thrusts one arm upward, matching the reference motion. The character's blue hair, pink top, patterned shorts, shoes, street scene, and static rear camera framing remain consistent with the source.
arguments.requested_change: Change the person's action to raising both hands in celebration, then thrusting one hand upward, while preserving the person's identity, appearance, scene, lighting, and camera framing.
unexpected_changes: The character's lower body moves more dynamically during the celebration, including a slight hop/turn, which is more pronounced than the source's mostly standing pose.
